title: Horseradish Sour
notes: This cocktail is a longtime favourite and best seller at Wildebeest not least because it goes great with any meat-forward dish. The soothing honey and punch of horseradish is also the perfect tonic if you are feeling a bit run down.

methodSections.heading: Horseradish Sour
steps: Add all ingredients to a cocktail shaker full of ice.
Shake and strain into a chilled low ball glass.
